environment: Owner Mac (macOS 25.6.0 arm64, node 26.8.2) writing to an exclusively-owned PostgreSQL 16.15 database on loopback. The real live production model is the input; production itself is untouched.

commands.action: Apply the 36-migration chain to a fresh owned database
Import the real live production model
commands.command: node tools/v5-migration/cli.js load --model <private live model> --run e2e-run --database-url postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:50709/v5_e2e --environment test --adopt-existing

commands.action: Import the same model a second time under the same run id
Import under a fresh run id into the same target

result.note: only the three seeded singletons are re-adopted via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE; every other row already exists and is verified

assertions: Every durable family is imported: 2 actors, 2 eligibility rows, 2 profiles, 2 identities, 2 email credentials, 2 profile saves, the friendship edge and 2 social outcomes, 2 wallets, 2 ratings, 48 economy command outcomes, 4 wallet ledger entries, 2 matches with 4 participants and 36 move outcomes, 1 tournament room with 7 party command outcomes, 136 rate buckets, 2 outbox rows, 5000 support events, the league week singleton and the system-burns singleton.
Per-actor currency is exact: the two wallets carry 150 and 157 coins with zero reserved and zero crowns, matching the live source.
The four journal rows are imported verbatim and reconcile exactly to those balances (opening 150 per actor, plus mints of 2 and 5 for one actor), so no invented migration-baseline row was required.
Identity and profile state is exact: both tags, usernames, display names, avatars and version counters, with the email credential salt and hash preserved verbatim.

Both FINISHED matches keep their status, escrow 0, settled flag, accepted count 2, receipt payout/burn 0 and their receipt reasons; the tournament room keeps its CANCELLED status, owner, escrow and its tournament-2 shape version.
Coverage is complete: 5245 source locators recorded with their dispositions and zero unclassified, and 5272 row-ledger entries.
The importer writes no TRUNCATE, DROP, DELETE or ALTER statement; an unknown target is refused and a row not created by a same-fingerprint run is a hard refusal rather than an overwrite.
A second import under the same run id writes nothing and verifies all 5272 rows; a fresh run id converges, writing only the three singleton rows that are re-adopted.

not_claimed: Production writes, production restore or cutover
sanitized_summary: The importer projects the complete live production model into the normalized schema in 70 deterministic batches across 61 durable families, with a coverage row for every source locator and a hash ledger for every written row. Per-actor wallets, journal, identities, profiles, matches, receipts and the tournament room all match the source exactly, zero locators are unclassified, and a repeated import is a verified no-op while a fresh run id converges.
review_notes: Only counts, hashes and structural facts are recorded here; no actor id, email address, credential value or raw row is reproduced. Production was never opened for write.
